title: PlayerShop
description: Modern Chest Shop plugin with the best and cleanest user interface.
body: Text Transcript PLAYERSHOP - Free Resource Modern Chest Shop plugin with the best and cleanest user interface. Discord Support & Document Page Database Support: MySQL & H2 support Version Support: Always the newest versions! Optimized Plugin: The plugin does not cause lags PlaceholderAPI: The plugin support PlaceholderAPI MODERN SOLUTIONS The plugin uses GUIs, built-in Holograms and modern UIs with sounds, messages etc. Shift + Right click with a item and create a shop! MULTIPLE CURRENCY SUPPORT The plugin supports multiple currency plugins and allows players to switch between them through a fully configurable system. INTERACTIVE SHOP SYSTEM Players can adjust the amount directly in the GUI when using the chest shop.
